class.name: z1_controllers/Z1JointTrajectoryController
class.description: Torque (effort) controller for the Z1 arm that executes FollowJointTrajectory goals with the official Unitree torque law (tau = Kp*(q_des - q) + Kd*(qdot_des - qdot), clamped to the effort limit) and writes to the joints' effort command interfaces.
